coverage: sun letters: ر #1, س #2, ص #3, ت #4, ل #5, ض #6, ش #7. Starting an ayah: #1 #2 #4 #5 #7; joined after a word: #3; a one-word ayah, stopped: #6. ن is left out on purpose: every ن sun word carries the untaught نّ غنة.
notes: Round 1: ٱلنَّاسِ (114:2) removed (arid keeps that word, the repetition the learner complained of); ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ is the anchor and وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ (79:3) a new hear. None of the core is from الناس: its only other sun word, ٱلَّذِى, is the ibtida anchor. Notice is the classic pair that names the two lessons: وَٱلشَّمْسِ (91:1) / وَٱلْقَمَرِ (91:2). ٱلَّذِينَ (1:7) went to tabii; وَٱلَّيْلِ (92:1, old) gives the ل. Later rules flagged (ibtida, dad-zha on ض) sit on the merged letter's شدة or before it and do not change the silent ل.

noticeText.en: Listen to ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ, وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ and ٱلصِّرَٰطَ: the ل of ال is silent and the next letter is doubled.
noticeText.ar: استمع إلى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ووَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ وٱلصِّرَٰطَ: لام ال لا تُنطق، والحرف الذي بعدها مشدد.

examples.note: The ل is not said; it merges into the ر, which is doubled.
examples.noteAr: اللام لا تُنطق، بل تُدغم في الراء فتُشدَّد.
examples.why: Old anchor, from الفاتحة, known to every learner. Starting the ayah, the ٱ has a فتحة, then straight to the doubled ر.
examples.source: تحفة الأطفال، البيت 24–29، https://shamela.ws/book/9632/5; هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/204–206 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: The ل is not said; it merges into the س, which is doubled.
examples.noteAr: اللام لا تُنطق، بل تُدغم في السين فتُشدَّد.
examples.why: Starts the ayah, joined to سَبْحًا; only a مد طبيعي (taught) besides. A light sun letter next to the heavy ص of #3.
examples.source: تحفة الأطفال، البيت 24–29، https://shamela.ws/book/9632/5; هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/204–206 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: The ل is not said; it merges into the ص, which is doubled.
examples.noteAr: اللام لا تُنطق، بل تُدغم في الصاد فتُشدَّد.
examples.why: From الفاتحة, joined after ٱهْدِنَا; a heavy sun letter (tafkhim, taught).
examples.source: تحفة الأطفال، البيت 24–29، https://shamela.ws/book/9632/5; هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/204–206 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: The ل is not said; it merges into the ت, which is doubled.
examples.noteAr: اللام لا تُنطق، بل تُدغم في التاء فتُشدَّد.
examples.why: Old example, kept: short, opens التين.
examples.source: تحفة الأطفال، البيت 24–29، https://shamela.ws/book/9632/5; هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/204–206 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: The ل of ال merges into the ل after it: one doubled ل.
examples.noteAr: لام ال تُدغم في اللام بعدها: لام واحدة مشددة.
examples.why: Old example, kept: the ل-into-ل case, where learners say two separate ل. Data warning: the data marks lam_shamsiyyah only before the other sun letters, not ل+ل; ل is a sun letter («…للكرم» in تحفة الأطفال) and the شدة on the second ل shows the merge.
examples.source: تحفة الأطفال، البيت 24–29، https://shamela.ws/book/9632/5; هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/204–206 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: The ل is not said; it merges into the ض, which is doubled.
examples.noteAr: اللام لا تُنطق، بل تُدغم في الضاد فتُشدَّد.
examples.why: Old example, kept: a one-word ayah. The ض has its own lesson later (dad-zha); here only the silent ل.
examples.source: تحفة الأطفال، البيت 24–29، https://shamela.ws/book/9632/5; هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/204–206 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: The ل is silent and the ش is doubled: وَشَّمْسِ.
examples.noteAr: اللام لا تُنطق والشين مشددة: وَشَّمْسِ.
examples.why: The pair that names both lessons, in two consecutive ayat of الشمس.
examples.source: تحفة الأطفال، البيت 24–29، https://shamela.ws/book/9632/5; هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/204–206 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

contrast.note: Here the ل is said, with سكون, before the ق: وَلْقَمَرِ.
contrast.noteAr: هنا تُنطق اللام ساكنة قبل القاف: وَلْقَمَرِ.
contrast.why: Same pattern (وَ + ال + noun), the ل said.
